description.susinstantswap: Hold the inventory key to swap items with your hotbar. Coexists with vanilla — short press toggles inventory, long press swaps.
config.susinstantswap.title: Su's Instant Swap Config
config.susinstantswap.modEnabled.tooltip: Master switch — when off, the mod is completely disabled and E key behaves like vanilla.
config.susinstantswap.holdThresholdMs.to: Press duration above this is treated as long press. Range: 50-1000ms, default 200ms.
config.susinstantswap.soundEnabled.toolt: Play a sound when swapping items.
config.susinstantswap.mouseReposition.to: When opening a container or inventory, the mouse automatically moves to the bottom-right corner.
config.susinstantswap.guiSwapEnabled.too: In container screens, press the GUI swap key to directly swap items and close the screen.
config.susinstantswap.emptySlotSwapEnabl: Also perform the swap on empty slots.
config.susinstantswap.rowSwapEnabled.too: Show arrow icons next to survival inventory rows. Hover and hold E to swap the entire row with your hotbar.
config.susinstantswap.toastEnabled.toolt: Show action bar messages for warnings, errors, and info.
config.susinstantswap.debug.tooltip: Output debug messages to the game log.
toast.susinstantswap.empty_slot_swap_dis: Empty slot swap is disabled, cannot swap with empty slot
toast.susinstantswap.both_slots_empty: Both slots are empty, nothing to swap
toast.susinstantswap.not_player_inventor: Can only swap items in backpack or hotbar
toast.susinstantswap.item_not_placeable: The item in hand cannot be placed in this slot
toast.susinstantswap.armor_slot_mismatch: Item type does not match the equipment slot
toast.susinstantswap.unknown_error: An unknown error occurred, swap failed
